SELECT T1.ENTRUST_ID entrustId, T1.PORTFOLIO_ID portfolioId, T1.VDATE vdate, T1.MDATE mdate, T6.ASSET_TYPE1 assetType1,
T6.ASSET_TYPE1 type9, T6.ASSET_TYPE_10 type10, T6.ASSET_TYPE_11 type11,
T1.CCY ccy, T1.FINPROD_ID finprodId, T3.FINPROD_MARKET_ID finprodMarketId, T3.FINPROD_NAME finprodName, T1.PS ps, T1.ENTRUST_AMT entrustAmt, T1.CHL_ID, T1.PRO_AVAILABLE_CASH proAvailableCash, T1.ACC_AVAILABLE_CASH accAvailableCash, T1.REMARK remark, T1.COUNTER_ID counterId, T1.COUNTER_TRADER counterTrader, T1.CONTACT_INFO contactInfo, T2.TRADER trader, T1.INV_MANAGER_ID invManagerId FROM ETR_ENTRUST T1 LEFT JOIN ETR_DISTRIBUTE T2 ON T1.ENTRUST_ID = T2.ENTRUST_ID LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT T3 ON T1.FINPROD_ID = T3.FINPROD_ID LEFT JOIN ETR_ENTRUST_ADD T6 ON T1.ENTRUST_ID = T6.ENTRUST_ID
T1.ENTRUST_ID = #{entrustId}
